mutations.name: M1 the mapper stops branching on task_complete.error, so a failed turn publishes as a success
mutations.expectRed: live:and RUN_ERROR was emitted anyway, from task_complete.error

mutations.name: M2 the mapper stops withholding user and developer records
mutations.expectRed: live:NO event carries a withheld record's id as its messageId

mutations.name: M3 the tool identity becomes a synthesized key instead of the native call_id
mutations.expectRed: shape:toolCallId is the NATIVE call_id, not a synthesized key

mutations.name: M4 a list-shaped tool output is no longer serialized, so one of the two real shapes is dropped
mutations.replace:
if (typeof o === "string") return o;
  if (Array.isArray(o)) throw new Error("unexpected list output");
mutations.expectRed: shape:a LIST-shaped tool output still produces exactly one RESULT

mutations.name: M5 turn_aborted requires a turn id, turning a rare heterogeneity into a dead stream
mutations.replace:
if (turn === undefined) return null;
      const id = turn;
mutations.expectRed: shape:turn_aborted WITHOUT a turn id still ends the run

mutations.name: M6 the run stops being fenced on its turn, so any turn's completion closes it
mutations.replace:
const runId = open;
      const err = asRecord(payload.error);
mutations.expectRed: shape:a task_complete for a DIFFERENT turn does not close the open run

mutations.name: M7 the opaque reasoning blob is published alongside the summary
mutations.find:
if (text.length === 0) return null;
      const messageId = asString(payload.id) ?? `rsn:${runId}:${ts}`;

mutations.expectRed: shape:TOOL_CALL_RESULT carries the messageId section 3.1 owes, derived from the call id
